entries.title: Psalms 88:4
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Counted - l am given up by my friends for a lost man.

entries.title: Psalms 88:5
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Free - Well nigh discharged from the warfare of the present life, and entered as a member into the society of the dead. Whom - Thou seemest to neglect and bury in oblivion.

entries.title: Psalms 88:7
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Waves - With they judgments, breaking in furiously upon me like the waves of the sea.

entries.title: Psalms 88:10
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Wonders - In raising them to life. To praise thee - In this world?

entries.title: Psalms 88:12
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Forgetfulness - In the grave, where men are forgotten by their nearest relations.

entries.title: Psalms 88:13
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Prevent - Come to thee before the dawning of the day, or the rising of the sun.

entries.title: Psalms 88:17
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Water - As the waters of the sea encompass him who is in the midst of it.
